title: Numerical P8 soak and reliability qualification
objective: Replace the misleading 64-operation long-duration label with an honest source-bound numerical soak/reliability campaign that enforces work, duration, cancellation/recovery, and memory-growth thresholds while keeping routine CI bounded

oracles: Independent numerical residuals and deterministic cross-domain checks
Process/session memory samples with bounded robust growth slope

handoff.summary: Implemented an honest source-bound P8 reliability campaign: bounded fresh Node/Sage.js processes exercise seven numerical domains, validate results independently, force budget/cancellation/callback failures and recovery, and must reach a robust six-sample heap/RSS tail under absolute growth and peak limits. Release collection now emits one authenticated raw-sample receipt per platform and gate assembly requires all four receipts to bind the exact corresponding Node dist artifact. The former 64-cycle corpus case is accurately classified as fixed work, and the profiles/contracts are documented and tested.
risks: The deploy-digest lane concurrently owns authenticate-release-gate.cjs, so this lane intentionally does not add the four new numerical-soak category/path/schema expectations to that authenticator or its release-workflow fixture.

pnpm architecture:check passes package, numerical, native, Wasm capability/workload/resource, and CoWasm checks, then stops because architecture/optimizer-opportunities.manifest.json is already stale against its source input at base commit 65730b29 (expected 844b26d0..., recorded f1f0f990...).
next_steps: In the integration lane, authenticate numerical-soak-{linux-x64,linux-arm64,macos-arm64,windows-x64} at build/numerical-qualification/platform/<platform>/<platform>-soak.evidence.json with schema sagejs.numerical-soak-evidence/v1; update release-workflow fixtures/counts from five requirements/seven supplemental artifacts to six/eleven.

Add a scheduled workflow that builds once and invokes run-soak.cjs --profile scheduled with cancel-in-progress concurrency, fail-fast behavior, and a hard job timeout; routine push CI must not run the soak.
Update RELEASE.md to describe collection of the four source-bound soak records, then qualify the release profile concurrently on the persistent four-platform hosts.
